name: Header & Footer Builder – Rootblox
author: CozyThemes

sections.description:
RootBlox is a lightweight and flexible WordPress plugin that provides a collection of ready-made header and footer patterns, allowing you to build professional layouts within minutes. Designed for the block editor, RootBlox ensures easy customization, seamless integration, and a fully responsive design.

Try Rootblox on a dummy site!

Features

  • Pre-designed header and footer patterns
  • Fully customizable with the block editor
  • Quick and effortless setup
  • Compatible with any WordPress theme
  • Sticky Header
  • Responsive Header Options
  • AJAX-powered search
  • Contact Info Block
  • Dynamic Date for Copyright Text
  • Dynamic Business Hours Block

Whether you’re creating a new site or enhancing an existing one, RootBlox simplifies the process, letting you achieve a polished look without coding.

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or newer
  • PHP 7.3 or newer (recommended)

Installation

Direct from the Dashboard

  1. Go to WP Admin Dashboard > Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Rootblox”
  3. Click Install Now, and then activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Is Rootblox for Free?

Yes, it’s free and provides additional premium features.

Where do I report security bugs?

You can report any security bugs found in the source code of this plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment and take care of notifying the developers of this plugin.
